overall_assessment: All four pre-pass flags are false alarms: the two Vurderingsformer lines describe topics in music didactics, GRUSKU5100 has a complete one-line materials note, and VERK2100 has a legitimate long bibliography. The extractor preserves the learning-outcome groups, detailed DID subcourses and explicit PPU exam-entry gates. The controls show a recurring mix of teaching activities and subject matter, residual resit rules and several missed academic prerequisites.

findings.evidence:
Individuell undervisning med hovedinstrumentlærer
Akkompagnement med instituttets akkompagnatør
findings.description: At least six random controls place discrete delivery activities such as individual lessons, masterclasses, workshops or independent rehearsal in course_content. HINS2200's course_content row consists entirely of teaching activities. KAM4300 combines distinct repertoire categories and teaching activities within one block.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due heading override in R/institution_config.R maps all of Undervisning og læringsformer to course_content. The specification documents this behavior for the mixed blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Barratt Due refinement that moves standalone delivery lines and activity lists from this heading into teaching_methods, using the recurring main-instrument and chamber-music list wording. Keep subject entries such as Stemmeanatomi and chamber repertoire categories in course_content.

findings.evidence: Krav til forkunnskaper: Gjennomført 1.studieår bachelor i utøvende musikk.
findings.description: The explicit prior-study requirements in ENT2100 and SPIN5110 produce no prerequisites row. ENT2100 requires completion of year one and SPIN5110 names completion of years one and two as the normal expectation.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The labelled-facts reader passes the field to .admission_prerequisites() in R/extract_sections.R, whose positive prerequisite regex does not recognize these Gjennomført formulations with no Bestått or course code.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize Gjennomført and Normalt gjennomført followed by numbered study years in the labelled prerequisite field, including optional whitespace after the ordinal dot and a second year joined by og.

findings.description: The requirement to have passed KAM3300 is visible in the facts column but produces no prerequisites row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The facts-list reader in R/blocks.R relies on a mapped field label. The standalone Bestått line has no label and stays in facts.
findings.suggested_fix: In the Barratt Due facts reader, route otherwise unlabelled items starting with Bestått and a course code to the existing prerequisite filter. Check standalone lines in a facts item as well as separate list items.

findings.description: Both DID plans require approval of participation in mandatory courses. The named instrumental technique and body awareness course remains in course_content and is absent from coursework_requirements, which correctly contains each plan's other obligatory-course list.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The inline coursework splitter handles the standalone Obligatorisk kurs label and its list. The inline colon form and the sentence form with i fail to move.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the Barratt Due coursework extraction to move the complete standalone line when Obligatorisk kurs is immediately followed by an inline title after a colon or by i and a title. Preserve the current handling for a separate list.

findings.evidence: Gjennomført undervisning og arbeidskrav er gyldige i to semestre etter ordinær eksamen.
findings.description: SGRU1300 and SPIN5110 keep the validity period of completed coursework in teaching_methods, leaving that condition out of coursework_requirements. Their source uses the plural gyldige.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due .sentence_moves rule in R/extract_sections.R ends its pattern at a word boundary after singular gyldig.
findings.suggested_fix: Allow both gyldig and gyldige in the existing sentence move to coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Den delen som ikke er bestått må gjennomføres på nytt. Deretter gis det ny samlet vurdering.
findings.description: Assessment still retains recurring resit policies after the logistics cleanup. The three PPU plans tell students to repeat the failed component and receive a new overall result. Other plans retain generic instructions to repeat all or part of a course, or repeat the ordinary exam format as a resit. These lines add no ordinary assessment design and appear in suspects and controls.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Ny vurdering maps to assessment and is merged with the ordinary design before cleanup. R/extract_sections.R removes examiner and deadline lines but deliberately preserves several stock resit formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep Barratt Due Ny vurdering blocks distinct until cleanup. Remove the repeated PPU failed-component policy, generic course-repeat instructions and resit lines that merely repeat the ordinary format. Preserve a distinct assessment design if one is specified.

findings.description: The source explicitly designates portfolio assessment in these two overviews. The ordinary assessment rows retain details about the assessed work and grading but omit that designation. HINS1200 names the portfolio only in the resit line.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due labelled-facts reader recognizes the prerequisite label but leaves the summary assessment-form label in facts.
findings.suggested_fix: Read Avsluttende vurdering from the facts column and use its value to supplement the ordinary assessment row when the detailed text does not already name the same form.

findings.evidence: Opptak i emnet forutsetter at kriterier som besetning og repertoar oppfylles på bakgrunn av søkermasse og tilgjengelig undervisningsressurs.
findings.description: Elective admission, priority and capacity rules remain inside course_content. KAMFOR5100 describes selection by applicant pool and teaching resources. SPIN5110 retains the priority for graduating students and allocation according to staff availability.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due Undervisning og læringsformer override sends the entire block to course_content. Section cleanup does not filter these elective-allocation sentences from that target.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply a Barratt Due sentence filter for its explicit elective selection and capacity phrases, including Opptak i emnet forutsetter and the SPIN5110 priority and allocation sentences. Preserve the repertoire descriptions and instrument list.
